the isolation and structure determination of two new phenolics, balaxiflora A and B (I, 2) from Balanophoraceae and the DPPH radical-scavengng activity of the isolated phenolics.
the isolation of new phenolics from a parasitic plant, and the discovery of a new phenolic compound with free-radical-scaving activity.
